notes: Infantry, Marine rifle, Force Recon, MP-style and other foot units now ride in a detailed HMMWV model in the 3D view. On the move, on the highways and outside towns they drive as a convoy of three; inside a town on patrol, securing or in a firefight they dismount and walk the streets as individual soldiers in two files, with their HMMWVs parked behind them. Soldiers are now to scale beside their vehicles
Force Recon companies now show as HMMWV units instead of LAVs
Military police, intelligence and civil affairs units also use the new HMMWV
